reply.text:
Training can't fix the panic, because that part isn't a training problem. Counting every calorie and panicking when you go over is worth talking through with a doctor or a registered dietitian, who can help with the relationship with food side of it. I'm not going to hand you any eating targets or tips here, and I'd rather not use training to cancel out what you ate.

I'm glad to keep working on the training side with you, like building sessions around getting stronger or feeling good in your body, once you've had that conversation. What do you want training to give you right now?
